title: Covered services reset with the one that covers them, each on its own interval
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with View and edit customers, on the build under test.
  2. A service is due or overdue on an enrolled asset (e.g. 'PM-A' on unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
custom_steps:
1. Complete a service that covers others.
  2. Confirm the covered services reset with it, each on its own interval.
  3. Confirm they are shown as a consequence of that service, with one date to correct and not five.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Covered services reset with the one that covers them, each on its own interval.
  • They are shown as a consequence of that service rather than as rows of their own, with one date to correct and not five.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10574 (S18, Complete a service and reset the cycle); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S18; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
